why_ai: Damaged vehicles are repaired by hand in the shop; hidden damage and paint matching need experienced eyes.
why_clarity: A repaired car is checkable against OEM spec, but paint matching and hidden damage vary job to job.
why_digital: Starts from a wrecked car and ends with a physically repaired car handed back locally.

why_ai: Physical fit and corrosion testing plus factory audits back a certification insurers specify by name.
why_clarity: Parts pass or fail defined tests against OEM equivalents on a recurring renewal cycle.
why_digital: Work starts from physical parts in a lab; the certification decision itself ships as a document.

why_ai: Desk research and forecasting are automatable; member-contributed data and standards stewardship give partial protection.
why_clarity: Annual forecasts recur on a fixed calendar but their accuracy is only known years later.
why_digital: Member sales data in, reports and data standards out, all delivered online.

why_ai: Multi-year hand craftsmanship on unique cars where owners pay for a specific restorer's skill.
why_clarity: Every project is one-off, scope evolves on disassembly, and quality is partly taste.
why_digital: The input is a physical car and the deliverable is metal, paint and upholstery done by hand.

why_ai: Peer groups run on the facilitator's relationships, though benchmark reporting itself is easily automated.
why_clarity: Benchmarks are measurable but advice quality on insurer negotiation shows up slowly.
why_digital: Financial data in and reports out, with quarterly peer meetings partly in person.

why_ai: Box trucks and upfit vans are repaired by hand in specialised large bays for fleet managers.
why_clarity: Repairs are checkable, but varied commercial vehicles and upfits limit repetition.
why_digital: Physical commercial vehicles are repaired on site for local fleet customers.

why_ai: Appraisals are used in litigation and umpire disputes where a named human appraiser must defend them.
why_clarity: Output is a dollar figure from a repeatable method, but correctness is settled by negotiation.
why_digital: Vehicle inspection and market data feed a written appraisal delivered as a document.

why_ai: Decades of proprietary claim and supplement data lock in the platform every estimate is written against.
why_clarity: Labor times and parts data are built vehicle by vehicle to a codified structure.
why_digital: A licensed database built on screens and sold nationally to insurers and shops.

why_ai: Insurers require I-CAR credentials, and unresolved technician inquiries are novel technical questions.
why_clarity: Inquiry answers can be checked against OEM procedure, but curriculum quality is harder to measure.
why_digital: OEM documents in, bulletins and training out, with some hands-on instruction in person.

why_ai: Repairs are still hands-on, but insurers steer volume so the shop is largely interchangeable.
why_clarity: Insurer KPIs on cycle time, CSI and severity define and measure every job.
why_digital: Physical vehicles are repaired in the bay even though insurer reporting runs through portals.

why_ai: Physical crash testing and insurer-pooled loss data give a trusted institutional rating AI cannot replicate.
why_clarity: Crash test protocols are codified with objective results; loss research conclusions take longer to validate.
why_digital: Work mixes physical crash tests with data analysis, and ratings are published online.

why_ai: Acquisition and insurer negotiation decisions are high-stakes, though the analytics underneath are automatable.
why_clarity: Deal models follow known methods but whether an acquisition paid off is known years later.
why_digital: Network repair data in and models out, done entirely on screens for internal buyers.

why_ai: OEMs require on-site verification of equipment and training before a shop joins the network.
why_clarity: Audits follow a written OEM standard across thousands of shops each year with pass or fail outcomes.
why_digital: Auditors inspect physical facilities on site, then issue a digital certification decision.

why_ai: Lab formulation with real paint and millions of proprietary field spectro readings protects the work.
why_clarity: Colour match is measured objectively by spectrophotometer against each OEM colour.
why_digital: Physical paint samples are measured in a lab and formulas ship as databases with the paint.

why_ai: Technicians push dents out by hand with rods at the vehicle; no licence is involved.
why_clarity: Success is visible immediately, but the push technique is learned by feel.
why_digital: Mobile hands-on service at the car, found through dealer relationships and hail storms.

why_ai: Damage detection from photos is pattern matching that AI estimating tools already perform.
why_clarity: High-volume estimates follow database logic, checked later when supplements reveal misses.
why_digital: Phone photos in and a digital estimate out, all done on screen.

why_ai: Normalizing OEM documentation is text work LLMs handle; licensing and support history give partial protection.
why_clarity: Procedures are structured vehicle by vehicle to a fixed schema at high volume.
why_digital: OEM documents in and a searchable subscription database out, sold nationally online.

why_ai: Repairs are still hands-on, but speed-focused cosmetic work makes the shop a commodity.
why_clarity: Fast cosmetic repairs to pass platform inspection give a clear, checkable target.
why_digital: A physical car is repaired at a local shop near where drivers work.

why_ai: Hands-on repair of varied vehicles by the only local shop for an hour around.
why_clarity: Work ranges from deer strikes to farm equipment, so few jobs repeat.
why_digital: Handwritten estimates, whiteboards and face-to-face local customers within a 50-mile radius.

why_ai: Legislative advocacy against insurers depends on relationships and adversarial political judgment.
why_clarity: Advocacy success depends on legislative outcomes that arrive slowly and ambiguously.
why_digital: Surveys and position papers are digital, but testimony and member work happen in person.

why_ai: Supplement identification is predictable pattern work AI can draft; negotiation adds modest adversarial judgment.
why_clarity: Approved supplement dollars measure success, though arguments vary by insurer.
why_digital: Starts from teardown inspection of the car, then runs through insurer portals on screen.

why_ai: State-regulated, legally challenged reports built on decades of proprietary transaction data.
why_clarity: Comparable selection and adjustments follow a defined method across huge claim volumes.
why_digital: Transaction data in and a valuation report out, sold nationally to insurers.
